## LTX-2.5 MSR keyframes + optional dialog - RTX 3090

**Length**: group 2 `duration seconds` (5 -> 121 frames, 10 -> 241 frames @24fps). 10 s needs much more VRAM: use 768x448 or UD-Q5/Q4 if OOM.
**Resolution**: stage-1 width/height (/32); final = x2 (960x544 -> 1920x1088).

**Keyframes (anti-drift)**
- START: required. END: on by default (same characters, final positions). No END wanted -> Ctrl+B both `END guide` nodes.
- MID-A / MID-B: bypassed. To use one: Ctrl+B its LoadImage + preprocess + **both** guide nodes (stage 1 and 2).
- Set `frame_idx` to the frame where the image must appear (e.g. 5 s: 60 = middle; 10 s: 80, 160). Use the SAME value in both stages (if 2 stages). Any position, not only the middle.
- Keyframes must be the same scene/characters/lighting, only poses/positions change, else you get morphs/cuts.

**MSR refs**: pic1/pic2 = character portraits (clean, one person each), linked to both MSR guides. 3rd character: link pic3 IMAGE to `pic3` on BOTH MSR guides. Refs must be contiguous. Name them `Image 1/2/3` in the prompt.
Needs custom node ComfyUI-LTX2.5-MSR + LTX-2.5-Licon-MSR-V2 LoRA.

**Dialog audio (pre-generated voices)**
- Bypassed by default -> LTX generates its own audio/speech from the prompt.
- To use your track: Ctrl+B the 4 nodes in group 4c + `Use dialog audio` node. The audio is locked (mask 0), LTX lip-syncs the video to it. Longer audio is cut, shorter is padded and the rest is generated.
- Make the audio the same length as the video (5 s / 10 s). Write in the prompt who says which line so the right mouth moves.
- `audio_ref1/2` on the MSR guide are different: voice *identity* references (need an AVref LoRA), not a dialog track.

nodes.title: HOW TO: MSR References, Length & Resolution
widgets_values:
## HOW TO: MSR References, Length & Resolution

### 1. Required setup
- Custom node: `ComfyUI-LTX2.5-MSR` (`liconstudio/ComfyUI-LTX2.5-MSR`)
- LoRA: `LTX-2.5-Licon-MSR-V2.safetensors` in `models/loras/`
- If you use your `ltx25_uncensored_*` GGUF/CLIP/VAE files, select them in Group 1 loaders.

### 2. How to use MSR references (`pic1`..`pic4` + `background`)
- `pic1` is required. Keep character portraits contiguous (`pic1`, `pic2`, `pic3`...).
- For fewer refs: disconnect unused `picN` links on **BOTH** Stage 1 & Stage 2 MSR guide nodes (or only Stage 1 in Single-Stage).
- In your prompt, refer to them explicitly as **`Image 1`**, **`Image 2`**, **`Image 3`**... and state who does what ("Image 1 on the left talks to Image 2 on the right").
- **Keep `LTXVCropGuides` enabled** — it strips the reference frames before decode.

### 3. Length & Resolution (RTX 3090 24 GB)
- MSR uses more VRAM than plain I2V -> start at **`832×480`** (2-stage -> `1664×960`) or **`768×448`** (2-stage -> `1536×896`) and **`5s`** (121 frames).
- Width/height must be **divisible by 32**; frames must be **`8n + 1`** (`97`, `121`, `145`, `193`, `241` @ 24fps).
- If OOM: lower `VAEDecodeTiled` `tile_size` (`512` -> `256`), reduce resolution, or use fewer reference images.

groups.title: 4. Keyframes: START + END on, MID-A / MID-B bypassed (Ctrl+B to toggle image AND both its guide nodes)
4b. MSR character refs: pic1+pic2 linked; pic3/background NOT linked - drag IMAGE to both MSR guides to use
4c. DIALOG audio - bypassed by default. To use: select this group + 'Use dialog audio' node -> Ctrl+B
5b. Stage 2 - latent x2 upscale + refine (same keyframes)
